about_short_description.short_description: Caire Health provides software that improves the speed and accuracy of brain bleed diagnosis.

product.name: Caire Head CT
product.description: A software solution designed to assist in the diagnosis of brain bleeds by detecting or ruling out intracranial hemorrhages (ICH) and providing detailed subclassifications.

product.name: ICH Diagnostics
product.description: A diagnostic tool that immediately detects or rules out intracranial hemorrhages.

product.name: ICH Segmentation
product.description: A feature that localizes an intracranial hemorrhage and quantifies its volume.

product.name: Midline Shift Analysis
product.description: A tool that identifies the degree of midline shift in brain imaging.

product.name: Calvarial Fracture Detection
product.description: A feature that detects or rules out calvarial fractures.

product.name: Ventricle Segmentation
product.description: A tool that quantifies ventricle volume automatically.
